title: Attack
desc: A terrorist attack renders Arjun paralysed and traumatised with thoughts of his dead lover. When the attacker returns, Arjun puts his life on the line to serve his nation and seek revenge.

title: Khiladi Khel Ka
desc: A man poses as a tantric to earn money for his love interest's orphanage. However, things take a turn when a ghost begins to follow him after he pretends to perform an exorcism.

title: Tholi Prema
desc: Fate offers Aditya and Varsha the opportunity to rekindle their youthful romance years after personality differences compelled them to go their separate ways.

title: Maayon
desc: An archaeological team arrives at a historical temple to learn about its secrets. Meanwhile, a group of idol smugglers plan to steal the hidden treasure inside the temple.

title: 90ML
desc: A man with fetal alcohol syndrome keeps himself alive by drinking a certain amount of alcohol. However, things change when he falls in love with a beautiful woman.

title: Lungi
desc: A young man faces a difficult choice between moving to Dubai for employment and setting up his own business. As he tries to find direction in his life, he falls in love.

title: Fukrey 3
desc: The Fukras plan to take over Delhi and run for city elections. However, they have no money, so they take on an international job to make a quick buck, which changes their lives forever.
